messages.content: What was the full name king of England in 1800?

function.name: monarch_getMonarchOfYear
function.description: Retrieve the monarch of a specific location during a specified year. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location (e.g., country) whose monarch needs to be found.

year.description: The year to search the monarch.

fullName.description: If true, returns the full name and title of the monarch.

message.reasoning:
The user asks "What was the full name king of England in 1800?" They want the full name of the King of England in 1800.

We need to retrieve the monarch of England in 1800. We can use the tool `monarch_getMonarchOfYear` with location="England" or maybe "United Kingdom"? But historically, in 1800, there was no United Kingdom yet; it became UK in 1707 as Great Britain, but still called "King of Great Britain". However question says "king of England", so we should provide the monarch who reigned over England at that time. In 1800, George III was king. Full name: George William Frederick Ernest Augustus. Actually his full name includes many names: He was known as George III, born on June 20, 1738, died January 29, 1820. His full name: George William Frederick Ernest Augustus. So answer: George William Frederick Ernest Augustus, King of Great Britain and Ireland (or just King of England). Provide that.

But let's confirm via tool. We'll call the function.
